title: John Doe Remorph
script:
--hi this is my script
--IF YOU FOUYND THIS BY A GUEST ACCOUNT THEN THATS ME BEFORE I MADE MY ACCOUNT
--So like. this can be a little glitchy with player models that have layered clothing but it should be fine most of the time
--REMINDER. this is Client sided so other people wont see that youre john doe
--have fun with this !!!!!!!!!!!

--if you found any glitches with this Then open da console and let me know, thank you!!

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
 
local TargetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Killers.JohnDoe.Rig
 
for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		part.Transparency = 1
	end
end
 
local expression = character:FindFirstChild("ExpressionHolder")
if expression then
	local face = expression:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
	if face then face:Destroy() end
end
 
local DieStupidModel = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
if DieStupidModel then
	DieStupidModel:Destroy()
end
 
local ClonedModel = nil
local ClonedModelForCloned1 = TargetModel:Clone()
 
local ClonedParticles = {}
 
for _, des in pairs(ClonedModelForCloned1:GetDescendants()) do
	if des:IsA("Part") then
		des:Destroy()
	end
	if des:IsA("Humanoid") then
		des:Destroy()
	end
	if des:IsA("BodyColors") then
		des:Destroy()
	end
end
 
ClonedModel = ClonedModelForCloned1
ClonedModel.Parent = character
 
local RigModel = ClonedModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")
local Head = RigModel:FindFirstChild("Head")
local Torso = RigModel:FindFirstChild("Torso")
local LeftArm = RigModel:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
local RightArm = RigModel:FindFirstChild("Spike Arm")
local LeftLeg = RigModel:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
local RightLeg = RigModel:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
 
function weldpart(part0, part1)
	for _, weld in pairs(part0:GetDescendants()) do
		if weld:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			weld:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local weld1 = Instance.new("Weld", part1)
	weld1.Part0 = part0
	weld1.Part1 = part1
	weld1.Name = part1.Name
	part1.CanCollide = false
	return weld1
end
 
weldpart(character.Head, Head)
weldpart(character.Torso, Torso)
weldpart(character["Left Arm"], LeftArm)
weldpart(character["Right Arm"], RightArm)
weldpart(character["Left Leg"], LeftLeg)
weldpart(character["Right Leg"], RightLeg)
 
for _, des in pairs(ClonedModel:GetDescendants()) do
	if des:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		table.insert(ClonedParticles, des)
		des.Parent = character[des.Parent.Name]
	end
	if des:IsA("MeshPart") then
		des.CanCollide = false
		des.CanTouch = false
		des.CanQuery = false
	end
end
 
game:GetService("TestService"):Message("John doe re-morph successfully executed!")
features:
what does this script do? It just turns you into john doe! yeah thats literally it

when i figure out how to add animations ill add them aswell
NOTE: this is client sided. nobody will see you being john doe except for you

also note that its quite buggy because for some reason the collision doesnt turn off
